name: Benedikt Löbbecke
bio: I am a freelance software developer from Munich working with android for about 10 years for customers including Daimler, Allianz and ING. In my latest project I am supporting the apps Team of the Otto shopping app, one of the best known shopping apps in Germany. Besides this I enjoy working on open source android libraries related to app localisation as well as private projects around KMP and app security.
